text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's maddening run as she 
pushed to exceed her limits... held the 
spectators completely captivated all the 
way until she crossed the finish line.

Though she claimed victory in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), she felt that something was 
still missing to reach the "Edge of 
Possibility."

No matter how much she thought, no answer 
came... Thus began the days of searching 
for that missing "something" needed to 
reach "beyond the limit."
